📢 IMPORTANT — Instagram style guide:

Profile dekho: https://www.instagram.com/ai_use_assam (@ai_use_assam)

1. PEHLE profile kholkar purani POSTS aur REELS dhyaan se dekho — style, layout, colors, text placement samjho.
2. Nayi POST usi style me banao — same look & feel.
3. Phir USI POST ko lekar REEL banao — post wali images ko video me convert karo taaki post aur reel ek jaise lagein.
4. Simple background par sirf text MAT karo — post jaisa rich design chahiye.

Pehle dekho, phir banao. Style match hona chahiye!
